iterations.highest_value_visible_defect: The long pre-release close still read too much like a rigid diagonal translating left before the late compression key; the first half was carrying distance more strongly than authored load.
iterations.correction: Sink B pelvis earlier at K1/K2, hold head/chest farther right, raise rear arm while dropping the opposing hand, deepen unequal knees, and break the early hold/bridge cadence so preparation changes internal shape before the burst.

iterations.highest_value_visible_defect: The recovery arm descended through Actor A upper-body space, visually implying an unearned contact even though the source evidence leaves contact endpoints unresolved.
iterations.correction: Raise K7/K8 rear-arm arc above A into clear negative space; keep B root monotonic leftward and leave the arm late/high so recovery debt remains without reverse recoil or false contact.

iterations.visible_basis: Ordered 12 fps review of the actual compiled MP4 shows progressive asymmetrical sink/load, a crooked max-compression spring, a sharp release cut at the measured burst, committed crossing, monotonic leftward root travel, a high counter-arc through open negative space, and a non-idle recovery-debt settle. No bridge invents a support owner or discrete contact.
